description:
At Meraki FW , we understand that every premium handbag is more than just an accessory— it is a masterpiece of art, precision, and passion. While our artisans bring these designs to life on the production floor, it is our Merchandising team that turns these concepts into a global success story.
We are looking for a dedicated and fluent Merchandiser to join our team. You will be the strategic bridge between the customer's vision and our manufacturing capabilities. In this role, you aren’t just managing orders; you are the professional voice of our company, navigating the complex journey of an order from the initial Purchase Order (PO) to the final shipment. If you are detail-oriented, possess excellent communication skills, and are proficient in handling data, this is your opportunity to play a pivotal role in the growth of Meraki FW.
JOB DESCRIPTION:
At MERAKI FW, our Merchandisers are the heart of our operations. You are the vital link that connects our customers’ visions with our artisan production capabilities. We are looking for a detail-oriented Merchandiser to join our team, ensuring that every order is executed with precision, transparency, and timely delivery.
Order Coordination & Execution
* Order Tracking: Monitor the entire lifecycle of production orders, from the initial sampling stage to final shipment, ensuring strict adherence to timelines.
* Customer Liaison: Serve as the primary point of contact for international clients, providing regular updates on production status and managing expectations.
* Internal Collaboration: Work closely with the Sourcing, Planning, and Production teams to ensure all materials and components are ready according to the production schedule.
Communication & Reporting
* Status Reporting: Prepare and maintain comprehensive order tracking reports, highlighting any potential delays or issues and proactively proposing solutions.
* Technical Communication: Translate customer requirements into clear, actionable instructions for our internal manufacturing and technical teams.
Quality & Process Compliance
* Compliance Monitoring: Ensure that all products meet the specific quality standards, packaging requirements, and ethical compliance requested by global brands.
